title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENVI - NonResidentialBuilding
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4envi/NonResidentialBuilding. Building for any use other than residential. Subclass of s4envi:Building (ETSI TS 103 410-2 clause 6.2.1.1.4); all Building/Perimeter attributes (location, consistsOf, population, address) are inherited, not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NonResidentialBuilding'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.
